protocol.claim: Determine a tested lower bound or reproducible operational boundary for simultaneous market WebSockets from one observed egress; no assumption that a timeout is an IP connection cap.
protocol.address_family: IPv4 first, automatic family selection disabled
protocol.success: Both valid book snapshots on every requested socket, OPEN state, at least one PONG per socket, PONG age <=15 seconds, no unexpected close or error during hold
protocol.stop_policy: Stop on explicit overload/throttling, non-recoverable close/error, exhausted transport budget, or local resource guard
protocol.hold_policy: Fixed wall-clock window, replace lifecycle retirements and report population dips
protocol.market_selection: All markets ranked by observed Gamma volume24hr descending, eligible binary only
protocol.lifecycle_policy: Retire unavailable/resolved markets with recorded evidence; replace and report every population dip without restarting the observation
protocol.frame_recording: All initial snapshot frames and PONGs, then at most one update frame per connection per ten seconds

measurement.conclusion: Observed operational failure; inspect evidence before claiming an IP cap

interpretation: Observed concurrent admissions; maintained windows report actual population dips and heartbeat freshness separately. No absolute IP cap is established.
caveats: One ramp, not independent repeated saturation trials.
Observed live traffic does not establish a true worst case.
Volume24hr ranks historical trading volume, not instantaneous order-book update frequency.

measurement_notes.interpretation: Each target receives a fixed five-minute wall-clock observation after initialization. Market lifecycle replacements and bounded code-1006 transport replacements are recorded; a passed end-of-window gate is not a guarantee of uninterrupted per-feed delivery.

failure_classification.exchange: HTTP admission rejection or explicit non-lifecycle server close; rate and count limits remain distinct
failure_classification.client: Resource, output, memory, wall-time, or receive-processing limit
failure_classification.lifecycle: Explicit resolved-assets close or metadata/book API evidence that a requested market is unavailable

measurement_notes.activity: All frame bytes and update events counted. Initial snapshots and all PONGs retained; other updates sampled at most once per connection per ten seconds. Additional lower-volume markets do not establish equally active throughput capacity.
measurement_notes.source: The captured harness.mjs and its recorded SHA256 identify the exact measured code.

evidence: Full per-connection receipts and stage cohorts remain in the recording directory; the shareable export contains aggregates.
